offering_description.value: Operates and supports a network of aesthetic, cosmetic surgery and related medical clinics, mainly in Japan under the Shonan Beauty Clinic brand, serving individual patients. It also provides franchise support, medical devices, cosmetics and supplies to affiliated clinics.

primary_products.value: medical devices for aesthetics; cosmetics and skincare products; medical supplies and pharmaceuticals; health supplements

primary_services.value: aesthetic and cosmetic surgery treatments; dermatology and hair removal; clinic management and franchise support; clinic marketing and consulting

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual patients seeking aesthetic and cosmetic procedures; B2B: affiliated and franchised clinics, medical corporations buying devices, supplies and management services

end_markets.value: aesthetic medicine; cosmetic surgery; elective healthcare

revenue_model.value: service fees: patient payments for elective aesthetic procedures and treatments; product sales: devices, cosmetics, supplies sold to affiliated clinics; commissions or management fees: franchise and management fees from affiliated clinics
revenue_model.category: service fees; product sales; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: clinic management and treatment services to patients and affiliated clinics; brand owner: clinic brands and cosmetics made by third parties, sold to patients and clinics; distributor: purchases medical devices and supplies, sold to affiliated clinics

geography_served.value: global: Mainly Japan, plus clinics in the US, Taiwan, Southeast Asia and other Asian markets

specialization.value: related lines: aesthetic clinic treatments, clinic management support, medical devices and cosmetics

distribution_channels.value: own locations: directly operated and affiliated aesthetic clinics; direct sales: devices and supplies sold to affiliated clinics; online: patient bookings and some cosmetics sales

regulatory_exposure.value: high: medical practice and devices regulated by Japan's Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare, plus FDA and local health authorities abroad

notes: Details on geography and product mix are from general knowledge and may be imprecise.
